description: This file defines a React component called ForgotPasswordModal, which renders a modal dialog allowing users to input their email address to reset a password. It includes UI elements like buttons with different layouts for mobile and desktop, and utilizes shared components and Material-UI components.

classes.name: ForgotPasswordModal
classes.description: A React component for a modal that facilitates password reset via email.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component and binds event handlers.

methods.name: onEmailChanged
methods.description: Callback to handle changes in the email input field, updating state and validation.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the JSX to render the modal dialog with input, buttons, and layout.
